customManagers.description: MediaMTX static binary version pinned as a Dockerfile ARG

packageRules.description: Low-risk: auto-merge minor/patch once CI is green

High-risk: the SSO monkeypatch targets pyalarmdotcomajax internals; aiortc/av must keep manylinux wheels and aiortc.sdp is a private import; aiohttp/websockets carry the deprecation exposure (ClientSession/AppKey/legacy protocol aliases); MediaMTX config format can change. Never auto-merge -- review with CI.

aiortc pins av<18.0.0. Renovate reads camera-bridge/requirements.txt without resolving that transitive constraint, so it proposed av 18 and CI rejected it with ResolutionImpossible. Cap av here until aiortc relaxes its pin, then raise this bound in the same change.

CI's Python and the runtime image must move TOGETHER: the workflow's setup-python mirrors camera-bridge/Dockerfile's FROM python:<ver>-slim, and testing on an interpreter the container does not run is worse than not testing. Renovate already reports both under the dep name 'python'; this pins them into one PR and requires review, because a runtime interpreter bump for a 24/7 service is not an auto-merge.
